A fixing device for a position-adjusting jig is configured to quickly and accurately secure the jig at a predetermined operating position. The device includes a driving cylinder having a reciprocating piston, a fixing unit coupled to the piston, a guide block that guides movement of the fixing unit, and a position-fixing bracket provided at a selected location on the jig. When the driving cylinder is actuated, the piston moves the fixing unit along the guide block so that the fixing unit engages the position-fixing bracket. This engagement restrains the jig and maintains it in the required position during a manufacturing or assembly operation. When the cylinder is operated in the opposite direction, the fixing unit is disengaged from the bracket, allowing the jig to be repositioned as necessary.

By automating the fixing and releasing operations, the device eliminates or minimizes manual alignment and fastening work. As a result, the time required to set up or change the jig can be substantially reduced. The guided engagement between the fixing unit and the bracket also provides repeatable positioning, improves operational precision, and reduces errors caused by inconsistent manual adjustment. Accordingly, the device helps maintain uniform product quality, supports efficient production, and prevents losses in labor productivity associated with lengthy jig-setting procedures or inaccurate positioning.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent abstract for a fixing device used with a position-adjusting jig, including a driving cylinder, jig-position-fixing unit, guide block, and position-fixing bracket.
counterfactuals.output: A fixing device for use with a position-adjusting jig includes a driving cylinder, a jig-position-fixing unit operatively connected to the driving cylinder, a guide block configured to guide movement of the jig-position-fixing unit, and a position-fixing bracket supporting the guide block. Actuation of the driving cylinder moves the jig-position-fixing unit along a predetermined path defined by the guide block between a released position, in which adjustment of the jig is permitted, and a fixing position, in which the jig is secured relative to the position-fixing bracket. The device enables reliable, repeatable positioning and rapid fixing and release of the jig.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention that automatically fixes an adjustable jig in a predetermined position using a piston-driven mechanism, and explain how it improves productivity and product quality.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention is an **automatic jig-positioning and locking system**. An adjustable jig moves along a guide, rail, or pivot to accommodate different workpieces. When the required setting is selected, a pneumatic or hydraulic piston drives a locating pin, wedge, clamp, or locking block into a corresponding positioning feature on the jig. This action pulls the jig against fixed reference surfaces and securely holds it in the predetermined position. Sensors or mechanical stops may confirm that the jig is correctly seated before machining, welding, assembly, or inspection begins.

The system improves performance in several ways:

- **Faster setup:** Operators no longer need to measure, align, and tighten the jig manually.
- **Repeatable positioning:** The piston applies consistent force and locates the jig against the same references each cycle.
- **Reduced human error:** Automatic locking prevents incorrect settings and incomplete clamping.
- **Higher productivity:** Shorter changeover times and automated operation increase production throughput.
- **Improved product quality:** Accurate, rigid positioning reduces dimensional variation, misalignment, and defects.
- **Greater safety:** The jig can be locked remotely and interlocked so that production starts only after correct positioning is verified.

Overall, the invention combines rapid adjustment with positive, repeatable fixation, enabling more consistent manufacturing with less downtime and rework.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a formal patent-style summary based on these components: driving cylinder 100, jig-position-fixing unit 200, guide block 300, position-fixing bracket 400, and position-adjustable jig B.
counterfactuals.output: A position-adjustable jig apparatus is disclosed. The apparatus includes a driving cylinder 100 configured to generate a linear driving force, a jig-position-fixing unit 200 operatively coupled to the driving cylinder 100 and configured to selectively fix or release a position-adjustable jig B, and a guide block 300 configured to guide movement of the jig-position-fixing unit 200 along a predetermined path. A position-fixing bracket 400 supports and positions at least one of the driving cylinder 100, the jig-position-fixing unit 200, and the guide block 300 relative to the position-adjustable jig B. In operation, actuation of the driving cylinder 100 moves the jig-position-fixing unit 200 under guidance of the guide block 300 between a fixing position, in which the position-adjustable jig B is restrained at a selected position, and a release position, in which adjustment of the position-adjustable jig B is permitted. The disclosed arrangement enables reliable jig positioning, repeatable fixation, and simplified positional adjustment while reducing unintended displacement during a work operation.

counterfactuals.prompt: Please prepare the “Summary of the Invention” section for a position-adjusting jig fixing device, identifying the relationships among its cylinder, piston, fixing unit, guide block, and bracket, followed by a statement of its industrial benefits.
counterfactuals.output:
## Summary of the Invention

The present invention provides a position-adjusting jig fixing device capable of accurately positioning and securely fixing a workpiece or jig. The device includes a cylinder, a piston reciprocally movable by operation of the cylinder, a fixing unit coupled to the piston, a guide block configured to guide movement of the fixing unit, and a bracket supporting the cylinder and the guide block.

The cylinder is mounted to the bracket such that the piston extends and retracts along a predetermined operating direction. The fixing unit is operatively connected to the piston and moves between a fixing position and a release position in response to movement of the piston. At least a portion of the fixing unit is slidably received in or otherwise guided by the guide block, thereby restricting unintended lateral displacement or rotation of the fixing unit. The guide block is positioned relative to the cylinder by the bracket so that the movement path of the fixing unit remains aligned with the movement direction of the piston. The bracket may further be configured for attachment to a jig plate, machine frame, or other support structure and may permit adjustment of the installed position of the device.

Through this arrangement, the driving force generated by the cylinder is transmitted through the piston to the fixing unit, while the guide block stabilizes and accurately directs the resulting movement. The fixing unit can therefore repeatedly engage and release a jig or workpiece at a selected position with improved positional consistency.

### Industrial Benefits

The position-adjusting jig fixing device provides reliable clamping, simplified positional adjustment, and repeatable operation. Guided movement of the fixing unit reduces misalignment, vibration, uneven loading, and wear on the piston and associated components. The device can shorten jig setup and changeover time, improve machining or assembly accuracy, reduce manual adjustment, and enhance production efficiency. Its compact and structurally simple arrangement is suitable for use in automated manufacturing, machining, welding, assembly, inspection, and other industrial processes requiring accurate and repeatable positioning and fixation.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
